title: Normalized tensor localization and simultaneous adjunction data
statement: For abelian monoidal preadditive categories with countable coproducts and ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define the signed total tensor on complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. A tensor localization consists of a derived tensor bifunctor and its universal left-derived comparison from tensor of localized complexes to localization of signed total tensor. For a prescribed additive right functor, a prescribed derived right functor and its comparison on complexes, an adjoint localization records an additive ordinary left adjoint, its universal left-derived comparison and derived adjunction, with the equation identifying the derived transpose of every comparison-applied chain map with localization of its ordinary transpose. For specified ordinary direct-image lax tensor maps, tensor-adjunction data record the ordinary strong pullback tensor comparison, its naturality and its adjunction-unit normalization, and the derived strong comparison with its full signed-total representative square, using the existing inverse-ordinary-comparison signed total tensorPullbackTotal of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Extract the counit-defined projection mate in the orientation of [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-arrows]. Define the derived-composition normalization to be the universal-unit square comparing a specified ordinary direct-image composition isomorphism with a specified derived composition isomorphism. Transport a tensor comparison along a natural isomorphism by whiskering the isomorphism and its product. These are data and compatibility predicates, not existence assertions. All category and localization universes are independent.
